swing: what management guides for FY2027 AI revenue, against a standing target of roughly $115B

scenarios.title: Guidance holds
scenarios.desc: FY27 AI revenue reaffirmed at ≥$115B, Google shift framed as a contained mix change. A cautious tape still caps the re-rating.

scenarios.title: Guidance trimmed
scenarios.desc: FY27 AI revenue guided to $100–112B, acknowledging the 8i Max mix shift.

scenarios.title: Guidance cut
scenarios.desc: FY27 AI revenue below $100B, or the 8i Max reduction shows up explicitly in backlog commentary.

scenarios.title: Cut plus contagion
scenarios.desc: A guidance cut compounds with Anthropic credit-exposure scrutiny and export-control or disclosure scrutiny reaching Broadcom.

alternative.label: the original weights used before adding the Nvidia factor (30/40/22/8, moves +16/−1/−15/−27%)
alternative.why: Part of the tail weight came from Nvidia-driven contagion, and Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang on 23 November weakened that channel.
